query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects project JOIN users actor ON actor.id = $1 WHERE project.id = $2 AND actor.active AND (actor.role IN ('owner', 'operator') OR (actor.role = 'developer' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships membership WHERE membership.team_id = project.team_id AND membership.user_id = actor.id AND membership.role = 'admin') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_memberships membership WHERE membership.project_id = project.id AND membership.user_id = actor.id AND membership.role = 'admin'))))) AS "value!"
